d: Short, messy dark olive hair with choppy bangs and an open-mouthed, wide-eyed expression in dark brown eyes. An adolescent with a slender build. Wearing an orange kimono-style top over a dark green pleated skirt, complemented by a dark green and red striped waist armor piece, and a single brown glove on the right hand. Holding a traditional wooden bow and carrying a quiver of arrows on the back.
